text: The profile change adds browser.theme.forced-colors-override.enabled with Boolean default true, and the accepted Thunderbird profile retains it. Its comment describes using the system theme and forced-colors palette for the application interface. mail/app/moz.build includes this file among preprocessed application preference files. Keep this exact declaration separate from browser.display.document_color_use=0, whose comment concerns high contrast in content on Mac/Linux, and from the preceding dark-private-windows comment. This comm-only source establishes the default and documented intent. Engine theme handling, third-party theme exceptions and actual rendered accessibility behavior remain unverified because no paired Gecko consumer source or runtime result supports those claims here.
title: Thunderbird declares the forced-colors theme override enabled by default
